tiers.primary: Official vendor or institution page, read directly
tiers.primary_snippet: Official page seen only via search-engine summary; page did not render for fetch
tiers.secondary: Blog, press or marketing; not independently verified

gh_app_rules.supports: Greenhouse Auto-Reject/Auto-Advance (Plus, Pro) and Auto-Tag fire on custom application question answers.

gh_parse_fail.supports: 2.5MB parse limit; placeholder data skipped; graphics/photos/word art; image uploads; tables, headers, footers; contact info in headers/footers/text boxes; columns; inconsistent sections; letters separated by spaces; missing company identifiers; abbreviated titles; partial parses.

gh_blog_after_apply.supports: Auto-rejection is recruiter-set rules; 'AI doesn't score or rank applications'; AI suggests keywords for recruiter searches; >50% of roles email on auto-reject.

gh_unleash_2025.supports: May 2025: AI filters for years of experience and skills.

wd_parsing_admin.supports: Parsing results vary with resume format and word order; avoid images/image-based styles; Skills and Languages fields are not auto-filled.

wd_hiredscore_2026_08.supports: HiredScore Spotlight A/B/C/D grades; LLM evaluates each qualification against the parsed resume; basic quals decide A/B vs C/D; Fit & Gap view.

lever_parsing.supports: Lever parses Word/PDF/RTF/WordPerfect/HTML/ODF; cannot parse image files; if you can't highlight text it's likely unparseable.

lever_archive.supports: Automation commonly used to auto-archive candidates based on knockout questions.

icims_rolefit_2021.supports: iCIMS candidate ranking per job, tiers, available once Talent Cloud AI implemented.

taleo_prescreen.supports: Disqualification questions can instantly exit candidates; Required/Asset criteria; weighting; ACE alert tiers.

taleo_dq_23c.supports: Disqualification answers set to pass / disqualify / to be verified.

textkernel_getting_started.supports: Avoid PDF to minimize conversion problems; many PDFs parse fine; corrupt PDFs unrecoverable; OCR for scans (~5% of docs); graphic-design resumes poor.

rchilli_tips_2020.supports: Parser vendor tips: scanned/password/corrupt; PDF columns read left-first; header/footer ignored in doc/docx; tables; hidden fields; caps via formatting; combined/unusual headings; year-only dates and split date ranges break employers; split degree lines.

harvard_gazette_2021.supports: Fuller: half of US companies filter out applicants not employed in the last six months.

hbs_hidden_workers_register.supports: HBS/Accenture 2021: 88% (high-skill) / 94% (middle-skill) of employers say qualified candidates are vetted out for not matching exact criteria; >90% use RMS to filter or rank.

enhancv_recruiters_2025.supports: Vendor interviews, n=25 US recruiters: 92% say no auto-reject on formatting/content; knockout questions common; 44% have AI fit score, mostly used as a guide.

enhancv_columns_test.supports: Vendor extraction test: columns don't lose words but can break section order; LLM parse lost employer names 17% of the time with interleaving.

jobscan_tutorial.supports: Jobscan recommends >=75% match rate; weights hard skills; word count and measurable results not in match rate; 'designed to mimic' popular ATS.

myth_75_percent.supports: The '75% rejected by ATS' figure traces to a 2012 Preptel marketing claim.

hidden_text_builtin.supports: Greenhouse estimate ~1% of resumes contain hidden text; ATS show plain text; recruiters reject.

mobley_v_workday.supports: Mobley v. Workday ADEA collective conditionally certified May 2025.

anthropic_code_exec.supports: Code execution container pre-installs python-docx, pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab, python-dateutil; no internet.

anthropic_skills_overview.supports: Skill runtime constraints per surface; scripts run via bash and only output enters context; claude.ai network varies.
